productionNotes: Layer one clean guitar and one distorted guitar on the same part, pan them apart, and ride the clean layer louder in verses, the distorted layer louder in choruses.
Wide atmospheric reverb sends on chorus vocals and lead guitar. Keep verse vocals close and nearly dry so the chorus feels like the room opens up.
Drums pull back in verses: tighter kit, rim clicks or side stick, less cymbal wash. In choruses hit hard with open hats and crashes.
Tune low and let open low strings ring under moving chord shapes higher up the neck. The clash between the drone and the chord is the sound.
Whisper-to-wail vocal arc: intimate close-mic delivery in the verse, doubled and screamed layers stacked in the chorus.
Slow chorus effect or a subtle pitch shimmer on the clean guitars gives the verses that floating, underwater quality.
Bass sticks to guitar root notes with light drive so the low end stays solid even when the guitars go ambient.
Leave space. One sparse clean guitar figure and a vocal is a valid verse. Density is saved for the chorus.
